name: The Koi Whisperer of Mu
description: Swept black bars, overlapping scales and curling water. Listens to fish, and reports they have opinions.

designs.title: Koi Ascending
designs.description: A scaled koi climbing upstream between swept black bars, with little rings of water around it.

designs.title: Peony in Full Bloom
designs.description: A wide peony of many ruffled layers on dark leaves. Fills a shoulder or the outer thigh.

designs.title: Rising Wave
designs.description: A curling wave breaking over a sea of scale pattern, spray flying under a crescent moon.

designs.title: Blossom Bough
designs.description: A black branch heavy with notched blossoms and a few loose petals on their way down.

designs.title: Moon and Clouds
designs.description: Three curling cloud banks sliding across a large stippled moon. Calm work for the upper arm.

designs.title: Wave-Pattern Fan
designs.description: An open folding fan patterned with overlapping wave scales, its tassel trailing below.
